_readme: برومت لنانو بنانا لتوحيد صور معالم بنغازي.
_تحذير: جُرِّب هذا البرومت فغيّر ملامح المعالم. السبب ليس في صياغته:
نانو بنانا يعيد توليد كل بكسل من الصفر، ولا يملك وضع «حسّن فقط».
لا يوجد برومت يمنع الانحراف — يقلّله فقط.
لتحسين الجودة دون أي تغيير في الملامح استعمل:
قِيس على صور اختبار: التباين 34.2 -> 49.3 والميل اللوني 1.267 -> 1.042،
وعدد حواف المبنى لم يتغيّر. هذا تحويل حسابي لا يستطيع اختراع بنية.
أبقِ هذا الملف لحالة واحدة: معلم لا تملك صورته إطلاقًا، وتنشر الناتج
موسومًا بوضوح أنه تصوّر تخيّلي لا وثيقة.
intent: Prepare a real photograph of a real Benghazi landmark for use on a heritage website. This is a formatting and grading job, not a creative one.

source_photo.note: صورة فوتوغرافية حقيقية لمبنى قائم. ليست مرجعاً فنياً.

must_not: Do not invent, add, remove, or reshape any architectural element.
Do not change the number of windows, arches, domes, columns, balconies, or floors.
Do not repair, restore, or clean damage, cracks, missing masonry, or bullet marks. The damage is part of the record.
Do not add or remove people, vehicles, birds, boats, cables, or antennas.
Do not redraw, translate, straighten, or invent signage or Arabic lettering.
Do not change the time of day, season, weather, or the position of the sun.
Do not hallucinate detail into areas that are blurred, dark, or out of focus. Leave them soft.
Do not change the perspective, the lens character, or the vanishing points.
Do not stylise, illustrate, paint, or apply any artistic filter.
allowed_operations: Crop to the requested aspect ratio, keeping the landmark's full structure inside the frame.
Resize to the requested pixel dimensions.
Mild noise reduction that does not smear texture.
Straighten the horizon by up to 2 degrees if it is visibly tilted.

grade.target_look: Muted editorial documentary. Warm Mediterranean stone, deep shadows, restrained saturation.
grade.saturation: reduce by roughly 10 to 15 percent from the source
grade.shadows: keep deep, do not lift into grey
grade.warmth: very slightly warm, matching limestone and afternoon light
grade.grain: do not add — the site applies its own film grain in CSS

output_slots._pick_one: اختر slot واحداً لكل تصدير، وكرّر العملية بنفس الصورة لو احتجت أكثر من مقاس.

card.used_for: بطاقة البولارويد في كولاج المعالم — 19 صورة
card.framing: Landmark centred, full structure visible, generous headroom. It is displayed small, so it must read at a glance.

full.used_for: العرض الكامل عند الضغط على البطاقة
full.framing: Same crop as the card so the two match when the lightbox opens.

hero.framing: Wide establishing view with real foreground-to-background depth. The reveal window in the hero works on contrast, so flat, evenly-lit frames read as dead.

panel.framing: Tall vertical. Keep the lower third calm — a caption sits over it.

background.framing: Wide and calm. Text sits on top, so avoid busy centres.

paper.framing: Prefer a frame with a person in it — it gives the collage scale and life.

if_crop_would_cut_the_landmark: Do not extend, outpaint, or generate new edges. Return the image at the closest safe crop and say which slot it could not satisfy.
verification_before_delivery: Compare against the source: every architectural element must match one to one.
